title: One to two craft brought down per year at black sites

tellings.quote: There's also claims by Greer and others that at some of these black sites, um, one to two craft are brought down a year.

plain: At some secret military facilities, known as black sites, one or two unknown craft are brought down every year. The commentator who goes by UAPGerb, who says he has seen strange craft himself, passes this on as a claim made by the UFO researcher Steven Greer and others. If true, it would mean crashes and captures of such craft are routine rather than rare.
